question: Will the UAE talks happen, yes or no?

lines.text: The US has proposed three-way talks with Ukraine and Russia in the UAE, Zelensky says.
Now the Kremlin says a three-way meeting could happen soon.
Zelensky says the talks would be at a technical level, and Kyiv is waiting for a date.
CNN and Reuters report Trump's envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev in New York this week.
Ukraine's foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, says Kyiv is ready.

scene.quote: There are no obstacles on Ukraine's side. We are ready for meetings in this format.

lines.text: But he says Kyiv has received no signals that Russia is ready.
Then Putin spoke. He told Russian journalists every peace proposal is on the table.

scene.quote: They are all on the table. It's all possible.

lines.text: But he says Russia must think carefully about its response.
Reuters notes the war is now four and a half years old.
The same day, officials say a Russian drone strike on Kyiv killed at least five people.
The UAE hosted three-way talks in January and February.
A March round in Abu Dhabi was postponed after war broke out in the Middle East.
No date has been set yet. Kyiv is waiting for Washington.
Will the UAE talks happen, yes or no?
